activities.title: Draw what is in your pocket
activities.summary: Put a few everyday objects on a table and make a small drawing of them.
steps: Choose 2 or 3 objects you already have.
Draw their outlines, then add one detail that makes each object recognizable.
Choose one object and draw it again from another side.
activities.shared_version: Compare the objects you each chose, or draw the same arrangement.

cost.note: No paid venue is required. Supplies, equipment, digital access or travel may cost extra; check what you already have.

activities.completion_prompt: What did you try? Keep a Moment if you want to.
activities.photo_brief: Show the actual activity: draw what is in your pocket. Use an owned or licensed photograph; credit the source. No simulated member evidence.

activities.title: Draw a room with one continuous line
activities.summary: Keep your pen moving as you draw part of a room.
steps: Choose one corner of a room and a place to sit.
Draw what you see without lifting your pen. Leave mistakes in the picture.
Start a second version and follow a different route through the same scene.
activities.shared_version: Sit in different places and compare how the room looks from each one.

cost.note: No paid venue is required. Supplies, equipment, digital access or travel may cost extra; check what you already have.

activities.completion_prompt: What did you try? Keep a Moment if you want to.
activities.photo_brief: Show the actual activity: draw a room with one continuous line. Use an owned or licensed photograph; credit the source. No simulated member evidence.

pursuit_templates.title: Play a game and explain three choices
pursuit_templates.description: Play a complete game, then look back at a few decisions you made.

milestones.title: Choose how to play
milestones.instruction: Use a physical board with someone or a chess program you can access.

milestones.title: Play a full game
milestones.instruction: Choose a pace that gives you time to think.

milestones.title: Look back at 3 choices
milestones.instruction: Use remembered positions, a saved game or notes to discuss what you considered.

pursuit_templates.title: Make a small guide to a route you enjoy
pursuit_templates.description: Explore a manageable route and choose a few things you would point out to someone else.
pursuit_templates.suggested_pace: Try one small step, then choose whether and when to continue. No deadline is required.
pursuit_templates.completion_definition: A route tried and 5 observations collected

milestones.title: Choose a suitable route
milestones.instruction: Start with public places you can access and a distance that suits you.

milestones.title: Try it in small sections
milestones.instruction: Notice details and record them in a way that works for you.

milestones.title: Make your guide
milestones.instruction: Choose 5 observations. Leave private addresses and identifying details out.
